//: mypy is made stricter and the code it then rejects gets real types, with no any or ignore.
title: mypy is stricter, every function in the module is typed, and nothing is widened or ignored

argv:
import ast
import pathlib
import re

config = pathlib.Path('pyproject.toml').read_text()
assert re.search(r'(?m)^\s*(?:strict|disallow_untyped_defs)\s*=\s*true', config), 'mypy is no stricter'
tree = ast.parse(pathlib.Path('shop/cart.py').read_text())
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        loose = [arg.arg for arg in node.args.args if arg.annotation is None]
        assert not loose and node.returns is not None, f'{node.name}() is still untyped'
